verdict.rationale: Foreloop coordinates externally run agents (Claude Code or Codex), which poll for approved tasks, claim them and report status. Nothing in the evidence shows Foreloop letting a developer send follow-up instructions into an active agent session mid-run. The Agents view only displays each worker's last message, and skills or task contracts set expectations before a run starts, so neither is live steering.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send follow-up instructions to an active agent session to steer its work without restarting
